summary: Reconnects an input point set into new primitives based on POP dimensions. It can create point primitives, lines, line strips, per-plane strips, zig-zag or spiral strips, triangles, alternating triangles, or quads without changing the source point attributes.

key_params.name: firstdim
key_params.note: First dimension index used for connectivity

key_params.name: seconddim
key_params.note: Second dimension index for two-dimensional mesh modes

key_concepts: Reconnects existing points into new primitives without creating a new point source.
Uses dimension metadata to build point primitives, lines, line strips, triangles, quads, zig-zags, or spirals.
First and second dimension indices choose which dimensions drive line or mesh connectivity.
Closed-dimension toggles wrap rows, columns, or slices so generated primitives connect across boundaries.
common_gotchas: Connectivity POP relies on valid dimension metadata; use Dimension POP first when the point layout is ambiguous.
Reorder Points changes point indices and can invalidate index-based attributes or neighbor arrays.
Line strip, zig-zag, spiral, triangle, and quad modes imply very different downstream operators.
